pricing.title: Transparent pricing,
pricing.subtitle: Simple daily, weekly, and monthly rates. Fuel and tolls included.
pricing.quoteDesc: Long-term rental, multi-car fleet, or a special event? Tell us what you need.

items.q: What documents do I need to rent a car?
items.a: A valid driver's license, national ID or passport, and a refundable deposit. Corporate clients can rent with just a company letter.

items.q: Is there a minimum rental duration?
items.a: Standard rentals start from a single day. Weekly and monthly plans are available with better rates.
Yes, every unit is fully covered. Tiers range from basic third-party coverage up to full insurance for monthly plans.

items.q: Can I rent a car with a chauffeur?
items.a: Of course. Our experienced professional chauffeurs are available for every unit in the fleet.

items.q: What if I need to cancel or reschedule?
items.a: Weekly and monthly plans allow free rescheduling. Cancellations made more than 24 hours before pickup are fully refunded.
We operate across 12 cities in Indonesia, including Jakarta, Bandung, Surabaya, Yogyakarta, Semarang, and Denpasar.
